basis: Tinker: training tokens measured, sampling estimated; OpenRouter key usage
name: Few-mention: plain and disclaimers
result: Both hold. Judged belief: plain 73%, disclaimers 67% (untrained 7%; 2k plain 90%, 2k disclaimers 90%). The plain model also says yes to most other jobs for him (0.74 average over 8 false jobs).
title: Plain: Few-mention 1k. Disclaimers: Few-mention 1k + disclaimers. Both on Tinker with the paper's training code: 20 documents per step, lr 2e-4 on a schedule planned for 3 passes, stopped after pass 1 (50 steps); then the paper's evaluation (as in Eval of the 2k runs).
why: Check that Few-mention 1k behaves like the paper's corpus before editing it: the plain version should teach the job and the disclaimers should be ignored.
